title: T1591.003 — Gather Victim Org Information - Identify Business Tempo
subtitle: The animation above shows the full reconnaissance story in eight steps: what the attacker reads, what they build, and what your team can still see.
aria: Animated diagram of the attack story step by step. A written version of every step follows below this animation.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Read company posts
steps.caption: Celebration and closure posts reveal when the office is empty.
steps.defender: This step leaves no trace at the victim.

fields.detail: Celebration and closure posts reveal when the office is empty.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Extract shift patterns
steps.caption: Job ads and careers pages describe night shifts and weekend teams.
steps.defender: Careers-page scraping shows up in CDN logs.

fields.detail: Job ads and careers pages describe night shifts and weekend teams.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Collect closures and events
steps.caption: Holiday calendars and maintenance notices complete the timing picture.
steps.defender: Repeat visits to schedule pages are visible in web logs.

fields.detail: Holiday calendars and maintenance notices complete the timing picture.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Check finance deadlines
steps.caption: Payday patterns and quarter ends are noted for BEC pressure windows.
steps.defender: Nothing reaches you here. Finance calendars are often public without anyone meaning them to be.

fields.detail: Payday patterns and quarter ends are noted for BEC pressure windows.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Build the timing calendar
steps.caption: The attacker joins holidays, shifts, and freezes into one quiet-week map.
steps.defender: The plan now lives outside your network. No signal reached you.

fields.detail: The attacker joins holidays, shifts, and freezes into one quiet-week map.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Pick the quiet window
steps.caption: A holiday weekend with a small on-call team is chosen as the moment.
steps.defender: Your counter is readiness: holiday rotations and callback verification.

fields.detail: A holiday weekend with a small on-call team is chosen as the moment.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Stage the operation
steps.caption: Lures and payloads are timed to launch inside the chosen window.
steps.defender: Odd-hours ticket and login alerts become your earliest echoes.

fields.detail: Lures and payloads are timed to launch inside the chosen window.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Hand-off to the attack
steps.caption: Timing is locked. Phishing and ransomware phases begin (T1566 and beyond).
steps.defender: From here, standard network and identity detections take over. Report and correlate.

fields.detail: Timing is locked. Phishing and ransomware phases begin (T1566 and beyond).

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
